## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D adventure/arcade RPG starring “Brinco, the jumping shepherd,” with open-world exploration, at least 15 increasingly difficult trails, side tasks, collectibles, and a minigame.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls and computer keyboard controls.

## Requirements
- User requested an open world with freedom to explore, 15+ levels with increasing difficulty, character power-ups, collectibles, and minigames.
- Optimize for mobile, while also supporting computer play.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a single-page Three.js experience with stylized geometric scenery and character models, avoiding external 3D asset dependencies.
- Used 15 named trails with increasing Starbell requirements, free trail selection, autosaved progress, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable game implementation in `index.html`: Brinco character, 15 trail regions, Starbells and treats, mission markers, upgrades, Mallow side task, fetch minigame, journal/map, responsive UI, keyboard and touch controls, and localStorage autosave.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; extracted module JavaScript and passed `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved screenshots at `screenshots/brinco.jpg` and `screenshots/brinco-game.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate gameplay, visual rendering, and mobile interactions; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the browser’s current rendered state; the last Playwright action opened the trail map by pressing `m`.
2. Exercise movement, jumping, collectibles, trail completion, minigame, touch layout, and reload/autosave behavior; correct issues found.
3. Fix visible quest copy in `index.html`: it always says “Find 3 Starbells” though later trails require more; the count itself is dynamic.
4. Consider adding a favicon to avoid the observed `/favicon.ico` 404.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation and UI.
- `screenshots/brinco-game.jpg`: Gameplay screenshot.
- `screenshots/brinco.jpg`: Intro screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.161.0/build/three.module.js`; internet access is required for the module.
- Playwright opened `http://localhost:3002`; console showed a favicon 404 and WebGL performance warnings, with no reported game-script error.
- The trail map allows selecting any of the 15 trails, including trails beyond the current progression.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D adventure/arcade RPG starring “Brinco, the jumping shepherd,” with open-world exploration, 15+ trails, side tasks, collectibles, and a minigame.
- Support mobile touch controls and computer keyboard controls.

## Requirements
- Open-world freedom, at least 15 increasingly difficult levels, character power-ups, collectibles, and minigames.
- Optimize for phones and tablets while supporting computer play.

## Decisions
- Use a single-page Three.js game with stylized geometric scenery and character models, avoiding external 3D assets.
- Provide 15 named trails with increasing Starbell requirements, free trail selection, autosaved progress, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html`, including Brinco, trails, collectibles, trail markers, Mallow’s side task, fetch minigame, journal/map, upgrades, responsive UI, keyboard/touch controls, and localStorage autosave.
- Added a favicon; adjusted fetch gameplay so the ball starts closer, respawns within a smaller radius, touch controls remain available during the minigame, and the fetch button highlights when in range.
- Passed `node --check` on the extracted module script; browser-tested desktop keyboard movement and Starbell pickup with no game-script console errors.
- Emulated coarse-pointer touch at 390×844: verified controls fit within the viewport, joystick responds to touch, and Fetch starts with touch controls visible and can register a catch.
- Captured and inspected mobile gameplay screenshots.

### Active
- Further validate trail completion and autosave/reload behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test trail completion and verify collected progress persists after reload.
2. Optionally complete more fetch catches and inspect other phone/tablet viewport sizes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation and UI.
- `screenshots/mobile.png`: Mobile viewport capture.
- `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png`: Mobile gameplay capture.
- `screenshots/mobile-fetch.png`: Fetch minigame capture.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.161.0/build/three.module.js`; internet is required for the module.
- A local server at `http://localhost:3002` was responding during validation.
- The trail map allows selecting any of the 15 trails, including trails beyond current progression.
